title: User Roles: What Can Each Role Access and Modify?
summary: Defines access and modification capabilities for Admin, Finance, and Auditor roles, including Admin’s $100,000 transaction approval limit. Covers who can create/edit/remove users, configure permissions, modify account settings, and who has 48-month read-only access to audit records.
faqs: What can an Admin approve up to, and what account settings can they modify?
What actions can Finance users take for payments, payables/receivables, and transaction approvals?
Can Finance users change global access policies or remove Admin privileges?
What does an Auditor role allow—specifically including the 48-month read-only window—and what can they not do?
Who can view and export complete account activity and audit records, and with what restrictions?
What guidance does the document give for assigning Admin, Finance, and Auditor roles?"
